change: BMP input to PNG, JPEG, WebP, and ICO uses a bounded 24/32-bit BI_RGB row decoder instead of Chromium ImageDecoder, which is unavailable for image/bmp on hosted Linux Chromium.

browserSmoke.command: npx playwright test tests/browser/image-conversions.spec.ts -g 'bmp-to-(png|jpeg|webp|ico) from test-pattern.bmp' --reporter=line

memoryFormula: peak complete Chromium process-tree private memory during conversion minus stable clean blank-Chromium process-tree private memory
scopeCaveat: The maximum-size three-run memory gate was repeated for BMP-to-PNG only. The same row decoder is shared by BMP-to-JPEG, WebP, and ICO, whose small-fixture browser tests passed; their maximum-size current-Chrome memory gates remain to be rerun. Hosted Linux verification of this change is pending.
